message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday falling on a Friday or a Monday (or a holiday that falls on a weekend and is observed on the nearest weekday).  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend Days Included | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Sat 31 Dec 2022 – Mon 2 Jan 2023 | The holiday falls on Sunday, so the weekend is extended to Monday. |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | Friday, Feb 20 | Fri 20 – Sun 22 | Creates a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | Fri 7 – Sun 9 | Good Friday is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | Mon 22 – Wed 24 | Celebrated in all provinces. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Mon 4 – Wed 6 | Federal holiday in all provinces. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 10 | Mon 10 – Wed 12 | Federal holiday in all provinces. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | Mon 25 – Wed 27 | Christmas is a statutory holiday in all provinces. |

> **Other holidays that did not create a long weekend in 2023**  
> • Canada Day (Sat Jul 1) – only a 2‑day weekend.  
> • Remembrance Day (Thu Nov 11) – no adjacent weekend days.  
> • Boxing Day (Tue Dec 26) – no adjacent weekend days.

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a calendar or holiday‑API database.  
2. **Flag** any holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on the nearest weekday).  
3. **Generate a 3‑day range** for UI display or scheduling logic.  

If you need the same information for other years or for specific provinces, let me know and I can help you generate or fetch that data!
